This feature relies on the download records saved by the downloader itself.

If you enable this feature, the downloader checks the download record before downloading each file. If it is a duplicate file, the downloader skips it (it will not download it).

After the downloader skips duplicate files, it shows the file ID list in the log at the top, for example:

<span class="log" style="color: inherit;"><span style="color:#d27e00">Skipped 1 file because of "Don't download duplicate files" : </span><br><a href="https://www.pixiv.net/n/25755517" target="_blank">25755517</a><br></span>

?> This feature takes effect during the download stage. If you want to skip already downloaded files during crawling, you can enable the crawl setting: "Don't crawl works that have been downloaded".

### Loose policy

Conditions checked: the ID of the work, and the posting date.

The file name is not checked.

This is the default value. If you still want to skip previously downloaded files after changing the file naming rule, you can choose the "Loose" mode.

### Strict policy

Conditions checked: the ID of the work, the posting date, and the file name.

If the file currently being downloaded has a download record, and all three conditions are exactly the same, the file is considered a duplicate file.

### Notes

If a file is skipped, some of its related tasks are also skipped, for example:
- Saving the metadata of the work
- Saving the description of the work
- Downloading the cover image of a novel
- Downloading the embedded images in a novel

However, the "Bookmark the work after downloading" feature is not affected.
